title: The parallel PostNewtonStep loop computes connectors with Python user functions in the threads
author: Claude-JG
description: revision2026c step RG7.8.5 (found in RG7.8.3): CSystem::PostNewtonStep runs listDiscontinuousIteration in the threads without regard to user functions; an ObjectConnectorRigidBodySpringDamper with a Python postNewtonStepUserFunction and numberOfThreads=4 hangs, as the worker thread waits for the GIL that the main thread holds (measured: 4 such connectors, 50 steps, no end after 60 s).
releaseNotes: The post-Newton step of the connectors runs in the main thread if one of them has a user function that is computed there, e.g. a Python postNewtonStepUserFunction of ObjectConnectorRigidBodySpringDamper, which hung with more than one thread; symbolicUserFunctionThreadsTest.py.
